properties.name: Opportunity Rover (MER-B)
properties.whyLeft: Engineered for 90 Martian days (Sols), Oppy operated for 15 years until a colossal planet-encircling dust storm blotted out the Sun in 2018, depleting its solar power arrays.
properties.scienceEnabled: Discovered hematite spherules nicknamed 'blueberries' and sulfate evaporite rocks, confirming that neutral-pH liquid water once flowed steadily across the Martian surface.
properties.nasaSource: NASA Planetary Data System (PDS) / Mars Trek
properties.funFact: Oppy completed a full marathon distance on another world, driving a cumulative total of 45.16 kilometers (28.06 miles)!

properties.name: Spirit Rover (MER-A)
properties.whyLeft: Became trapped in soft sandy terrain named 'Troy' in 2009 with a broken front wheel. Operated as a stationary science platform until freezing Martian winter temperatures silenced communications.
properties.scienceEnabled: When dragging its jammed right-front wheel, it inadvertently scraped open soil with 90% pure silica content, direct evidence of ancient volcanic hydrothermal hot springs suitable for microbial life.
properties.funFact: Spirit's accidental discovery of pure white silica came from a 'broken' wheel dragging through the dirt, turning a hardware failure into one of Mars exploration's greatest triumphs!

properties.name: Viking 1 Lander (Thomas Mutch Memorial Station)
properties.whyLeft: Humanity's first long-duration robotic mission on Mars. Silenced in November 1982 after an erroneous software command update from ground control overwrote antenna orientation parameters.
properties.scienceEnabled: Transmitted the first historic high-resolution photos and color panoramas from the Martian surface. Analyzed atmospheric composition, daily weather, and conducted automated biological soil tests.
properties.nasaSource: NASA Planetary Data System (PDS) / Mars Trek
properties.funFact: Viking 1 operated on nuclear decay power (RTG), allowing it to survive for 6 straight Earth years when engineers originally only guaranteed 90 days.

properties.name: Viking 2 Lander
properties.whyLeft: Stationary lander positioned in northern volcanic plains. Operated for nearly 4 Earth years until its secondary batteries failed completely.
properties.scienceEnabled: Operated a surface seismometer, monitored northern Martian winter frost condensations, and sampled boulders and drift material across Utopia Planitia.
properties.funFact: Viking 2 captured images of pure water-ice frost coating the red rocks around the lander during the Martian winter.

properties.name: Mars Pathfinder & Sojourner Rover (Carl Sagan Memorial Station)
properties.whyLeft: Pioneered the airbag landing system and deployed Sojourner, humanity's first wheeled rover on Mars. Communications ceased when the lander's master battery died.
properties.scienceEnabled: Proved mobile roving robotics were viable on alien terrain. Analyzed volcanic rocks named 'Barnacle Bill' and 'Yogi' using Alpha Proton X-ray Spectrometer (APXS).
properties.funFact: Sojourner was about the size of a microwave oven (weighing just 10.5 kg) and drove at a maximum speed of 1 centimeter per second!

properties.name: InSight Geophysical Lander
properties.whyLeft: Left stationary on Elysium Planitia after fine Martian atmospheric dust heavily coated its circular solar panels, cutting power generation below survival levels.
properties.scienceEnabled: Deployed SEIS (dome seismometer) directly onto Martian bedrock. Detected over 1,319 Marsquakes and meteorite impacts, mapping the depth of Mars's crust, mantle, and molten liquid core.
properties.nasaSource: NASA Planetary Data System (PDS) / Mars Trek
properties.funFact: InSight detected the biggest seismic quake ever measured on another planet: a magnitude 4.7 Marsquake in May 2022 that reverberated across the globe for 10 hours!

properties.name: Phoenix Mars Lander
properties.whyLeft: Stationary arctic lander. Completed primary science before extreme northern polar winter plunged the site into darkness and buried the lander under thick dry ice (frozen carbon dioxide).
properties.scienceEnabled: Scraped subterranean permafrost with its robotic arm, directly uncovering pure water ice centimeters beneath the red dust and analyzing alkaline soil chemistry suitable for asparagus growth.
properties.funFact: Phoenix photographed ice chips dug by its trench scoop that sublimated directly from solid into gas over 4 days, proving it was real water ice!

properties.name: Ingenuity Mars Helicopter
properties.whyLeft: Completed 72 powered flights across Mars (designed for only 5). Stationed permanently at 'Valinor Hills' after sustaining rotor blade tip damage during its final descent in January 2024.
properties.scienceEnabled: First powered aerodynamic flight on another planet. Served as an aerial scout for Perseverance rover, proving powered rotorcraft flight in Mars's ultra-thin atmosphere (1% of Earth's density).
properties.nasaSource: NASA Planetary Data System (PDS) / Mars Trek
properties.funFact: Carried a small swatch of muslin fabric from the wing of the 1903 Wright Brothers flyer attached under its solar panel!
